profile.headline: Junior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
“Beware of little expenses. A small leak will sink a great ship” – Benjamin Franklin. I am a logistics student at the University of North Texas. I have always excelled in math and find interest in keeping track of allocated resources and minimizing costs. Upon completion of my internship in August 2020, I will be looking for a job where I am able to analyze and execute logistic or supply chain decisions.

I constantly try to make myself better by having an open mind to new ideas and alternative solutions. I competed I think very creatively, allowing me to find solutions that might normally go overlooked. 

I am in the Honors College at University of North Texas and am a passionate logistics undergraduate. 

I am skilled in noticing details and trends in statistics. I have learned excellent people skills through my work experience. I am also a quick learner and can master advanced concepts quickly and relate those skills to other concepts.

I would love to hear about internship or job opportunities directly at trentbmiller@gmail.com.
